Class WriteTrackingServletOutputStream

java.lang.Object
java.io.OutputStream
jakarta.servlet.ServletOutputStream
org.jboss.resteasy.core.servlet.WriteTrackingServletOutputStream
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, Flushable, AutoCloseable
public class WriteTrackingServletOutputStream extends jakarta.servlet.ServletOutputStream
A ServletOutputStream which tracks whether any data has been written to the stream.
Author:
James R. Perkins
